title: AppRoleAssignment
description: Represents an app role assigned to a user, group, or service principal.

appRoleId.description: The identifier of the app role. Set to the default app role ID of 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 if not specified.

principalDisplayName.description: The display name of the principal (user, group, or service principal).

principalId.description: The unique identifier of the principal being granted the role.

principalType.description: The type of the assigned principal (User, Group, or ServicePrincipal).

resourceDisplayName.description: The display name of the resource application.

resourceId.description: The unique identifier of the resource service principal.
